test.prompt: Use the configured Notion MCP tools to fetch the configured People source at {{source}}. Report its identity, URL, visible properties, and whether at least one person or an honestly empty source was read. Make no changes.
test.expected_output: The configured Notion People source is fetched and described without a write.
assertions: The response identifies the fetched People source and URL.
Visible properties and at least one person or an honestly empty result are reported.

readiness.prompt: Use only read-only Notion MCP tools. Fetch the configured People source at {{source}} and inspect its schema plus a bounded sample of at most 10 records. Report structure and counts only; do not quote personal data or make changes.
